turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail: . Orders move through our system very quickly after checkout, so cancellation is only possible if the order has not yet been processed. If your order has already been processed, it cannot be cancelled. In that case, please allow it to be delivered and return it to us for a refund. If you return the whole order within 14 days of receiving it, we will also refund the cost of standard delivery for that order. If you selected a faster delivery service, we will refund only the standard delivery cost.
